targets.expected_type: ∀ {ι : Type u} (e : HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.Expr ι) (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ), HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.value (e.splitEval x) = e.eval (fun i => HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.value (x i))

∀ {ι : Type u} {E : Type v} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Preorder E] (e : HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.Expr ι) (s : Set E), Convex ℝ s → ∀ (f : ι → E → ℝ × ℝ), (∀ i, HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.Regular s (f i)) → HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.Regular s (fun x => e.splitEval (fun i => f i x))
